_comment: Stage 2's curated tier (docs/PRD-design-first-workflow.md, master tree F2b/F2c) — always shown, live tier (open-design daemon) layers on top when reachable. Tracked in git (not gitignored, unlike *.json session records) because this is shared reference-catalog content, not per-deployment secrets or ephemeral state. `added_at` drives F2b's >90-day staleness flag; `license` missing/null drives F2c's 'not usable without manual review' tag — both fields are required per entry, not inferred.
